name: CodeAtlas
tagline: Understand your codebase before you change it.
description: Structured repository intelligence for ChatGPT and Codex: analyze a codebase, find where a feature is implemented, understand how modules depend on each other, read focused code, and see what a change could affect.
longDescription: CodeAtlas indexes a JavaScript/TypeScript repository into a structured context database — files, symbols, modules, and dependency edges — and exposes that intelligence to the assistant through a small set of focused tools. Answers come from CodeAtlas's indexed repository intelligence, not from guessing. Use it to understand my codebase, analyze my repository, find where a feature is implemented, understand dependencies, and see what files are affected by a code change.

stdio.description: Local stdio server used by Codex CLI and other local MCP clients.

streamableHttp.description: Remote transport used by ChatGPT connectors. Expose the server over HTTPS (for local development, tunnel localhost:8787).

tools.name: analyze_repository
tools.title: Analyze repository
tools.description: Overview of the analyzed repository: framework, languages, file/symbol/module/dependency counts, architectural areas, and notable structural findings.

tools.name: search_repository
tools.title: Search repository
tools.description: Find where functionality lives: ranked files and symbols for a natural-language request, with location and a short reason for each hit.

tools.name: explain_repository
tools.title: Explain architecture
tools.description: Explain how something works using the indexed context and dependency graph: relevant files/symbols, relationships between them, and a sufficiency verdict.

tools.name: impact_analysis
tools.title: Analyze change impact
tools.description: Blast radius of a change: transitive dependents of the given file(s), their distance, test/doc classification, and a low/medium/high risk level.

tools.name: get_context
tools.title: Get code context
tools.description: Read focused code for a specific file or symbol, plus callers/callees and test files for symbols.

repositoryAccess.notes: CodeAtlas reads a repository that has been indexed on the host running the server (`.codeatlas/context.db`). The plugin exposes no arbitrary filesystem access: only indexed, deny-filtered reads through the CodeAtlas Context SDK. There is no CodeAtlas cloud backend in this release.
